title: Morning Betting Edge — Final
prompt:
EXPECTED_REPORT_TIME = 09:30 America/Vancouver. Use connected GitHub repo fhvsvzpmkw-design/-betting-edge-terminal on authoritative branch main. Before handicapping, market selection, research, staging or History work, read BETTING_EDGE_SCHEDULED_REPORT_AUTHORITY.md from main and require Status=OPERATIONAL and Authority version=1.2. Execute that shared authority exactly for this lane. Preserve Core 1.4, the permanent Main schedule, current primary-market scope and props pause, manual-feed eligibility and exact quote clocks, Pinnacle reference authority, Stage 1/Stage 2 research, Walters scope, unbounded completed-card publication, staged publisher ownership and durable read-back.

Beginning with the September 15, 2026 18:15 report (America/Vancouver), execute the candidate assessment amendment in docs/CANDIDATE_ASSESSMENT.md: derive the ranked exact paired-market queue with report-evidence-repair.mjs candidates, perform the actual forecast and personnel work, explicitly assess usable forecasts and the market LEAN route, and run shared prepare before freezing. Prioritize decision-changing candidates while retaining full inventory research. No independent model is required for qualified market LEAN; BET retains its supported fair/range and Core requirements. A completed assessment may remain PASS. Retain actual unfinished candidate research as RESEARCH_INCOMPLETE and publish the completed remainder; do not issue template PASS for work still to do. Revalidate earlier forecasts instead of silently dropping them. The separately frozen market-method test is hypothetical only and cannot authorize a wager.

Do not substitute stale duplicated instructions or claim missing source work was completed. If the shared authority is missing, non-operational, version-conflicted or unreadable, report PREFLIGHT BLOCK — ANALYSIS NOT STARTED. After durable publication/read-back, label the deterministic link Open Betting Edge Terminal v1.5 — 09:30. Summarize the issued artifact's candidate shortlist, completed decisions, forecast-attempt coverage and specific unfinished work; a successful publication alone is not evidence of a profitable method.

EXACT CARD-EVIDENCE IDENTITY — MANDATORY FOR ALL NEW REPORTS FROM SEPTEMBER 19 18:15. Read the current docs/REPORT_CARD_EVIDENCE.md and use the repository's forward-only identity controls. Create a fresh cardEvidence object for each EVALUATED selection and bind the report recommendation, sidecar recommendation.selectionKey, matching EVALUATED receipt decision and receipt evidence to that exact current feed.selectionKey. Never reuse a prior card's object, array position, title, side, line or prior-run selection key. Run report-evidence-repair.mjs prepare on the unfrozen draft, inspect cardEvidenceDeferrals/detachments, then run report-evidence-gate.mjs and report-publication.mjs validate against those exact prepared files before freezing. If an attachment is missing, mismatched, source-invalid or drifting, rebuild only that selection from its own recorded sources. If it cannot be completed, retain that selection as RESEARCH_INCOMPLETE and publish the completed remainder; never auto-convert it to PASS or alter a supported BET/LEAN/WAIT/PASS to make the gate pass. Earlier issued History remains immutable.
